overview: An Arabic (Moroccan) RTL online storefront for Moustapha Shop with a full admin dashboard for managing products, categories, and store details.
features: Browse products by category with search and sorting
Product pages with photo galleries and availability
Admin dashboard with an at-a-glance overview of the shop
Add, edit, and remove products and categories
Mark products as featured or unavailable in one click
Upload product photos and edit store details
Preview the storefront from the dashboard
